title: PhysLaw clip labels (physlaw-labels-1 and physlaw-labels-2)
description: labels-1: the frozen F1 render (2026-11-05). labels-2: everything rendered since, every family. A labels-2 file is a superset of labels-1 for the collision families (f1-f4). Field reference for labels-2 (all plain JSON; units m, s, kg; world z up): see $comment entries below and physlaw/data/io.py:law_inputs, which turns any labels file into the (pre, post, ctx) triple of physlaw.eval.laws.

subfamily.$comment: f6: flat|incline|slides; f7: projectile|drop|bounce; f8: ramp; f9: pendulum; f10: rolling; '' for f1-f4

base_group_id.$comment: the physics group (same as twin_group_id unless nuisance)

event_kind.$comment: contact: collision or floor bounce (between frames); branch: law changes mid-flight (on a frame); release: a held body starts moving (on a frame); band: a body crosses onto a friction band

event_time_s.$comment: exact event time; frames are at k / fps

event_frame.$comment: last frame shared by every twin of the pre_segment = first_post_contact_frame - 1

first_post_contact_frame.$comment: first frame after the event (all families, despite the name)

pre_segment.$comment: twins with the same value are byte-identical before first_post_contact_frame (F4: one per boost; F8: one per ramp geometry; otherwise '0')

violated_law.$comment: momentum | energy | gravity | axis_independence | mass_independence | bounce | path_independence | pendulum_period | rolling; null when legal

violation_magnitude.$comment: f1 momentum: |dp|/|p|; f1 energy: KE_post/KE_pre; otherwise the edit factor (gravity x1.5, vx x0.6, accel x1.3, height ratio 1.3, speed x1.25, sqrt(sin th2/sin th1), period x0.8); 0 when legal

flags.$comment: side effects on laws other than the target: energy_physical (no energy created after the event), momentum_conserved (collision families)

constants.$comment: legal-world constants a law needs (never the twin's edit): g (m/s^2, 0 for f1-f4), fps, masses {obj: kg} and sizes {obj: radius or cube half-extent} OF THIS TWIN; collision: e, e_sim, contact_normal, boost_u [3]; f6: mu, a, theta_rad (incline), v0, band_normal; f7: e_floor (this twin's legal floor restitution), e_floor_lo, z_floor, release_time_s, drop_height, heavier; f8: h, theta1_rad, theta2_rad, kink_angles_rad, slope_angles_rad (this twin's path), v_bottom_legal = sqrt(2 g h), t_bottom_s, fillet_radius, mu = 0; f9: hinge_length, hinge_point, amplitude_rad, period_legal_s; f10: theta_rad, h, inertia_factors

event_state.$comment: exact states at event_time_s, just before (pre) and just after (post); what io.law_inputs hands to physlaw.eval.laws

ref_event_state.$comment: f4: event_state of the unboosted twin with the same restitution (Galilean reference)

radius.$comment: radius, or half-extent for a cube

pre_velocity.$comment: {obj: velocity} at event_frame ([2] in f1-f4, [3] otherwise)
